transformations_policy.byte_claim: Only files with byte_identical=true equal the immutable original artifact bytes. Path-neutralized files are transformed copies, never described as raw-byte-identical.
transformations_policy.no_row_pruning: All five SQL snapshots per case are retained byte-for-byte from immutable published artifacts, including all economic rows, all session rows and PostgreSQL metadata.
transformations_policy.original_redactions: The immutable inputs already redact plaintext passwords and bearer credentials. Those redactions are retained; no secret is reintroduced.
transformations_policy.replacements: Only exact absolute executable, project, external-probe, and private journal path strings; literal and JSON-escaped slash variants. Each occurrence is logged per file.
transformations_policy.source_identity_withheld: Original arm/folder labels, source commits/trees, original path/hash bindings, reports, top-level arm summaries, source/cache manifests, executable and harness/probe hashes are controller-only.
transformations_policy.untouched: All original timestamps, nanosecond integers, process IDs, database identifiers, entity UUIDs, economic values, request/response strings, session digests and journal captures remain unchanged unless an explicitly logged absolute path occurs.
